accelerator.basis: CPU-only standard-library implementation; no accelerator runtime is imported or used.

ram.measurement: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04, normalized from KiB to bytes.
ram.planningBasis: 32 MiB is conservative headroom above the maximum peak RSS observed across the public Ubuntu 24.04 CI matrix; it is a planning estimate, not a hard runtime minimum.
